datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0S THRU BZT52C75S Surface Mount Zener Diodes (SOD-323), Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd

current.conditions: Specified forward test current IF = 10 mA, Ta = 25 degC

breakdown_voltage.conditions: Nominal zener voltage VZ @ IZT = 5 mA; datasheet limits: min 4.4 V, max 5.0 V; Ta = 25 degC

breakdown_current.conditions: Zener test current IZT at which VZ is specified; admissible zener current IZM = 5 mA as printed in the same row; Ta = 25 degC

extraction_notes: Family datasheet covering BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S; target part BZT52C4V7S (marking code W7) taken from its dedicated row on p. 2.
Zener voltage limits for BZT52C4V7S: min 4.4 V, nom 4.7 V, max 5.0 V at IZT = 5 mA (p. 2).
Zener impedance: ZZT = 80 ohm @ IZT = 5 mA; ZZK = 500 ohm @ IZK = 1.0 mA (p. 2).
Typical temperature coefficient @ IZTC: min -3.5 mV/degC, max 0.2 mV/degC (p. 2).
Package/thermal context: SOD-323, power dissipation 200 mW, typical RthJA = 417 degC/W, Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 degC (p. 1).

Forward voltage is given only as a single maximum rating (VF = 0.9 V @ IF = 10 mA, p. 1); the forward test current is recorded with source_kind 'typical' because it is the specified forcing condition, not a min/max limit.

Fig. 1 zener characteristic curves on p. 3 label traces for 2.4, 4.3, 5.1, 5.6, 6.2, 6.8, 7.5, 8.2, 9.1 and 10 V parts; no 4.7 V trace is labeled, and all figures are low-resolution raster family plots, so no part-specific curve digitization was performed.

Typical capacitance and leakage figures on p. 3 plot generic values versus nominal zener voltage on small log-log axes; reading a reliable value for VZ = 4.7 V was not possible, so capacitance is null and reverse_current comes from the table limit instead.
omission_reason: usable_curves is false because the datasheet's characteristic figures are generic family raster plots (Fig. 1 has no 4.7 V-labeled trace) and cannot be honestly digitized for this specific part; extraction relies on the part-specific electrical table rows and maximum ratings.
